build_control: Same /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source path, SDK, compiler, working directory and flags as R103; no production installation.
hypothesis: One shared empty 4096-byte receive buffer removes per-idle-client retention without per-serial-message reallocations. Partial frames and descriptor marks remain owned by their clients. Large bodies remain separately owned.
statistical_unit: Independent physical-router block; paired ratios within a block. Requests are not independent repetitions.
analysis: Exploratory screen, no superiority or equivalence verdict. Preserve every adverse direction and complete raw archive. No pooling older runs.
retention_rule: Correctness failure rejects candidate. In any CPU lane, >=3/4 positive before-pairs and median >1%, or p99 median >5% with >=3/4 positive pairs, requires independent frozen recheck before retention. Other adverse cells remain explicit. Memory counters are diagnostics, not precise PSS/peak.
failure_rule: Stop on any identity, correctness, health, cleanup or collection failure; preserve the failed window.
production: C throughout; private mount/PID/net namespace, guarded lifetime and cleanup per window.
pss: Unavailable on this kernel; write NA, never zero.
readiness: Exact HELLO, PING DATA and STATUS validation for every held connection; daemon fd count must increase by N and return to baseline.
excluded_tool_validation: probe-c was tool validation before freezing; excluded from this paired experiment.
